query: TACSTD2 thyroid cancer FDA approval clinical trial 2024 2025 2026 pharma press release
answer: FDA approved sevabertinib in 2025 for non-small cell lung cancer with HER2 mutations. No FDA approval for TACSTD2-related drugs in 2024-2026. No clinical trial results for TACSTD2 in the specified timeframe.

results.title: Oncology Drugs Fast-Tracked by the FDA in February 2026
results.content: On Feb. 4, [Oncolytics Biotech Inc. announced](https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/oncolytics-biotech-receives-fda-fast-135000618.html) that the FDA granted fast track designation to pelareorep, an [immunotherapy](/category/immunotherapy), in combination with [bevacizumab](https://www.oncologynewscentral.com/drugs/monograph/78648-304008/bevacizumab-intravenous) (Avastin) and FOLFIRI (leucovorin, fluorouracil, and irinotecan), for the treatment of patients with KRAS-mutated, microsatellite-stable metastatic [colorectal cancer](/category/colorectal-cancer) in the second-line setting. On Feb. 19, [Pilatus Biosciences Inc. announced](https://www.pilatusbio.com/latest-news/pilatus-biosciences-receives-fda-fast-track-designation-for-metabolic-checkpoint-inhibitor-plt012-in-hepatocellular-carcinoma) that the FDA granted fast track designation to PLT012, an anti-CD36 monoclonal antibody, for the treatment of patients with HCC. On Feb. 23, [Artios Pharma Limited announced](https://www.artios.com/press-release/artios-receives-u-s-fda-fast-track-designation-for-dna-polymerase-theta-pol%ce%b8-inhibitor-art6043-for-treatment-of-gbrca-mutated-her2-negative-breast-cancer/) that the FDA granted fast track designation to ART6043, a DNA polymerase theta inhibitor, in combination with [olaparib](https://www.oncologynewscentral.com/drugs/monograph/167487-315030/olaparib-oral) (Lynparza), a PARP inhibitor, for the treatment of adult patients with BRCA-mutated, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic [breast cancer](/category/breast-cancer) who have not received prior PARP therapy. On Feb. 24, [Aktis Oncology Inc. announced](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/aktis-oncology-receives-u-fda-130000308.html) that the FDA granted fast track designation to AKY-1189, a nectin-4 miniprotein radioconjugate, for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma (UC) who progressed on or after prior systemic therapies.

results.title: New FDA-Approved Oncology Drugs and Label Updates Between ...
results.content: **SEVABERTINIB (HYRNUO),** a kinase inhibitor that targets HER2 and EGFR, received accelerated approval for adults with locally advanced or metastatic, nonsquamous non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain (TKD) activating mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, and who have received a prior systemic therapy. **SUNVOZERTINIB (ZEGFROVY),** a tyrosine kinase inhibitor of EGFR, was granted accelerated approval for adults with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with *EGFR* exon 20 insertion mutations whose disease progressed after platinum-based chemotherapy. **LINVOSELTAMAB-GCPT (LYNOZYFIC),** a bispecific T-cell engager antibody, which works by binding to both the B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA) on cancer cells and the CD3 receptor on T cells, was granted accelerated approval for adults with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with four or more prior lines of therapy, including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory agent, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody. **DATOPOTAMAB DERUXTECAN-DLNK (DATROWAY),** an antibody-drug conjugate that targets TROP2 was granted accelerated approval for adults with *EGFR*-mutated locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC who received prior EGFR-directed therapy and platinum chemotherapy.
